gloss: to give up; to throw in the towel; to cry uncle

definitions.gloss: to give up; to throw in the towel; to complain that something is too hard
definitions.explanation: To admit that one cannot bear something any longer, crying out that it is too hard, too painful, or too much work.

examples.japanese: ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{音|ね}を{上|あ}げる。
⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{音|ね}を{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I cried uncle at the tough training.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{音|ね}を{上|あ}げなかった。
examples.english: Even when the overtime went on day after day, she never once complained that it was too much.

notes:
{音|ね} is an old word for a sound or cry, the reading also found in ⟦{本音|ほんね}→本音：06620_honne⟧. The thing that is too hard is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Very often negative, as praise for endurance: {音|ね}を{上|あ}げない, {音|ね}を{上|あ}げず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{音|ね}を{上|あ}げる: to give up at ~
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{音|ね}を{上|あ}げない: never once give up

WATCH OUT:
- Read ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧, not お⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: {音|おと}を{上|あ}げる is not a phrase.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up (a goal) — plain verb, no sense of crying out
- ⟦{降参|こうさん}→降参：15127_kousan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to surrender
- ⟦{弱音|よわね}を{吐|は}く→弱音を吐く：15321_yowanewohaku⟧: to whine, to say one can't go on — a close relative
